title: Bob: a vietnam hero ambushed and reincarnated in a fantasy world (Or just "BOB" i'm not sure)
author: Blake9712
selftext:
Hi pals and friends!

I wanted to share progress and ask for a little feedback on the project i've been working on when not at work for the past 7 months. As you may see from the title my game is called "BOB"; it's about a trashy guy in the 1960s (1967) who gets drafted into the vietnam war, however when trying to stop 911 he gets ambushed and isekei'd into some fantasy world with like, a Demon king, Dragons, you know how it is. But none of that exists yet, what I have is the Trailor park Trailor for the trailor park floor. 

So it is a rogue like and my biggest inspiration is the binding of isaac though the game play, theming and POV are entirely different from that. What it does have in common is random level (my equivalant to isaacs rooms) selection placed based on matching gates so the level to the left seemlessly connects to the level to the right in a way you won't notice and it's per seed, so every seed you will see different unique levels and in a different order. You see 8 levels per floor generation plus any alt path levels and there should be roughly 60 levels per floor. 

There are currently 131 equipable items and weapons created for the game, the goal is to make the different items and different actually feel unique, change the game play and run, and allow the player to create fun feeling synergies. IE combo the legendary item broken glasses which adds double shot with the ability to fly and a boosted grenade launcher and rain hellfire on your enemies, or double jump onto there head with some spikey shoes. You may also swing the tail of your dino costume to create some distance. The game play is very based on range and timing and it can still be altered a little bit for all that that entails.

My first 3 months on the project where just spent making the asset builder and it's been heavily tweaked and edited from there. Claude did do most of the coding, as of Opus 5.5 Claude has been able to handle the assets in the correct style that I am trying to go with very well. I still tend to modify and correct the assets Claude makes within the Asset Editor, but it is helpful when I can use Claude to make something like furniture which I can't be bothered to make. I do have a full time job after all, and the scope of this project is stealthily large.

Even though it's taken me a lot of work to get here I have a lot of work ahead of me and the number 1. Thing I can get is feedback. Note that I am making the game for me first and foremost, I just want to make the best game that I can and something that I myself would enjoy playing. I do fully intend to make a playable Demo whenever I complete the second floor. Technically I have a playable demo now, 10 minutes per run with everything you see, but stopping Bob at the Trailor Park would be like stopping Isaac at the Basement or stopping GTA V in North Yankton, and plus it should be more refined when i complete the next floor. I am aiming to complete that this year. I am aiming to complete the full game by the end of 2027 if I can make a floor under every 3 months.

Let me know your thoughts? Oh and the trailor was a Parody of GTA Vs "Why did I move here" Trailor, I had other ideas but they where all dumb and that one made me laugh.
